question: In event-driven algorithmic trading, when a rare exit-state failure is observed in live/final data but the validation split has zero positive examples, what robust validation and experiment design methods can be used to avoid overfitting while still improving exit policy? Focus on walk-forward validation, nested cross-validation for time series, purged/embargoed CV, rare event meta-labeling, sequential live shadow evaluation, and when to reject a strategy despite plausible final examples.
